info.name: gitops-api
info.description:
Full contract test suite for gitops-api (docs/API-CONTRACT.md).

Setup: import `gitops-api.postman_environment.json`, set `apiKey` to one of the keys in the service's `API_KEYS`, and set `baseUrl`. Then run the whole collection (Runner, or `newman run`).

Every response is also checked for the security headers and `x-request-id` (collection-level test).
